title: Loon's Retreat 30A | KEY.co
meta_description: Coastal haven with deeded beach access
description_expanded: Five beautifully designed bedrooms, including a custom bunk room, provide comfortable accommodations for families and groups. Outside, a private heated pool and hot tub offer a serene space for relaxation, surrounded by lush landscaping that enhances the sense of privacy. A convenient elevator adds ease to every level, while complimentary bikes and a six-seater golf cart make exploring the area simple and enjoyable. Just moments away, private deeded beach access leads to the iconic sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf, completing an unforgettable coastal escape where style, comfort, and location come together effortlessly. Contemporary design meets the relaxed elegance of the Gulf Coast in this newly constructed retreat along the peaceful west end of 30A. Thoughtfully designed interiors feature soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and sunlit open living spaces that create a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The gourmet kitchen flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas, while a stylish wet bar adds a sophisticated touch for casual gatherings or evening entertaining. Carefully selected finishes, layered textures, and designer lighting throughout the home reflect a refined coastal aesthetic that feels both luxurious and inviting.

Features: Backyard Pool Heated pool Hot tub
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
